title: Structs and impl: methods, Self and private fields
hints: Look at the README's 'New syntax' table: constructors are `fn new(...) -> Self`, readers take `&self`, changers `&mut self`, and `report` takes `self`. Fields are reached as `self.field`.

Ideas: `square` can call `Self::new`; `can_hold` compares both sides with `<=`; `scale` multiplies each field with `*=`; the thermostat clamps in `new` *and* in `adjust` (and counts every adjustment); `report` uses `format!` with an `if` to choose "change" or "changes".
E0616 'field is private' in tests/checks.rs means a check wants a getter: that's the point of private fields. E0596 'cannot borrow `*self` as mutable' means the method needs `&mut self`.

Same shapes on other data: `fn empty() -> Self { Self { items: Vec::new(), total: 0 } }` · `fn fits(&self, b: &Box3) -> bool { b.d <= self.d && b.w <= self.w }` · `fn louder(&mut self, by: u8) { self.vol = (self.vol + by).min(Self::MAX_VOL); }` · `format!("{} {}", n, if n == 1 { "song" } else { "songs" })`
